question: Jwala Gutta is an Indian professional _______ player.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Badminton.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Jwala Gutta** is a left-handed Indian Badminton Player. 
 
• She was born in **Wardha, Maharashtra** on **7th September 1983.**
 
• She received India’s second-highest sporting honor** ‘Arjuna Award’ in 2011.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Jwala Gutta**

 
 
• She played her debut match in **India Asia Satellite Tournament, in 2002.**
 
• Her favorite shot was "Forehand Service and Left Handed Stroke Play".
 
• **Career Best Ranking - **6th (Mixed Doubled) and 10th (Womens' Doubles)
 
• In her career spanning over a decade, she had a total of 165 wins and 167 losses to her credit.
 
• She is India's most successful doubles specialist and has won the National Badminton Championships fourteen times.
 
• She has won medals at all major international tournaments.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://www.sportzcraazy.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/jwala-gutta-featured-1280x720.jpg]
